page.layout: One printed page, left, blank except for a library stamp and show-through. At the right edge, the neighbouring page is only partly visible and is not transcribed.
page.notes: The left page is blank. The faint text across its upper and middle area is show-through from the reverse side and is not transcribed. The red oval stamp (Herzog August Bibliothek Wolfenbüttel) is a library stamp and is excluded. The right-hand strip shows the edge of the neighbouring page, including a partly visible title line ("ILL...", "PO...", "D M A...", "Comm..."), which is not transcribed because it belongs to the adjacent page and is cut off by the scan.
